chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, kote in note kiangah ka hong lutna uh a mawkna suak lo hi cih nomau mah in na thei uh hi.

Note in na theih uh mah bangin kote in Filippi khua-ah zawn’khalna leh bawlsiatnate ka thuak khit uh ciangin, i Pasian suangin nakpi-in nialna tawh Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu nomau kiangah lau loin ka hong hilh uh hi.
Kote in zuauthu hilhna, kihuaina, kheemna tawh hong hansuahin hong zol thei ka hi kei uh hi.
Lungdamna Thu zui dinga kilawm mi ci-in Pasian in ko hong koih mah bangin mite lungsim uh kimsak bang hi loin, lungsim a hong dongtel Pasian lungkimsak bangin thu ka hilh uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in na theih uh mah bangin, kote in mi phatna kam khat beek ka zang kei uh a, a kiseel huaihamna lungsim neu kha beek a om loh thu, Pasian in kote ading teci a pang hi.

Tua tham loin, Khazih’ sawltak ka hi uh ahih ciangin vangik a suan thei mi ka hi uh napi-in, mite’ piak minthan’na note kiangah ahi zongin, midangte kiangah ahi zongin zong loin, note lakah dam damin ka sem uh hi.
Note ka hong it mahmah uh a, nu in nawine naungeekte a khoi mah bangin kote in note hong it hong ngai-in, Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu tham loin, kote nuntakna uh nangawn piak nopna lungsim ka nei uh hi.

Ute naute aw, kote in gimpi mahmahin nasemin ka hahkatna thu uh na thei uh hi. Note lakah mi khat peuhmah tungah vangik ka suah loh nadingun kote in sun tawh, zan tawh nasemin Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu note kiangah ka hong hilh uh hi.

Amahmah Gam leh a vangliatna sungah hong sam, hong tungsak Pasian tawh a kilawm a kituak na gamtat nadingun pa in a tate a bawl mah bangin kote in note khempeuh bang ci bangin kong hansuah uh a, kong vaikhak uh note in na theih uh mah bangin upna sungah a tung note lakah kote in, bang ci bangin siangthoin, mawhsak nading om loin ka om uh note in, kote ading teci pang mi na hi uh hi; Pasian in zong ko ading teci pang mi ahi hi.

Ka hilh uh Pasian’ thu note in ngahin na san’ lai takun, mi kam sung pan a pusuak thu bangin sang loin, Pasian’ thu a man taktak hi ci-in a um note sungah a bawlpha Pasian’ thu bangin na san’na uh ngaihsunin, kote in Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat tawntung uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Judah gamah Khazih Zeisu sungah a om pawlpite in Judah mite’ khut tung pan gimna a thuak uh bangin, ute naute aw, note in zong na mipawlte khut sung uh ah tua bangin na thuak uh ahih ciangin, Judah gamah a om pawlpite bangin a gamta mi na hi uh hi.
Tua Judah mite in, Topa Zeisu akipan kamsangte a that zo uh hi. Kote zong hong hawlkhia uh a, Pasian lungsim tawh kituak loin mi khempeuh tawh zong kilem lo uh hi.
Tua mite in amau mawhna a dimsak tawntung nadingun Gentailte in gupna sungah a tun’ nadingun kote thuhilh hong khaam uh hi. Amau tungah hehna a vekpi-in a tung zo hi!
Ute naute aw, kote in lungsim tawh hi lo, pum bek tawh note tawh a tom kha i kikhen hangin, nomau maitang uh mu nuamin, kong ngaih mahmah uh lungsim tawh hahkat zaw-in ka om uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei Paul in note kiangah kong pai nading nihvei dong ka hanciam hangin Satan in kote hong kham hi.
I Topa Zeisu hong kum ciangin a mai-ah kote lametna, lungdamna leh kisaktheihna lukhu in bang ahi hiam? Note hilo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in kote minthan’na leh lungdamna na hi uh hi.
